skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals damage to a single target with 2 Combos for 120% ATK

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals damage to all targets with 4 Combos for 48% Max HP . After using Ultimate Skill, 1 defeated Character will return to the battle with 100% HP. Can trigger up to 4 times per battle.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals damage to all targets with 4 Combos for 64% Max HP (+2663). After using Ultimate Skill, 2 defeated Characters will return to the battle with 100% HP. Can trigger up to 6 times per battle.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: After taking an action or an ally takes an action, triggers [Evolve] on the target. Permanently grants immunity against [Silence] to all Allies in the row. Permanently increases own HP by points. [Evolve]: Immediately cancels the target’s Unyielding and Ignore DMG statuses.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: After taking an action or an ally takes an action, triggers [Evolve] on the target. Permanently grants immunity against [Stun/Silence] to all Allies in the row. This effect cannot be ignored. Permanently increases own HP by points. [Evolve]: Immediately cancels the target’s Unyielding and Ignore DMG statuses.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: After taking an action or surrounding allies take an action, triggers [Evolve] on the target. Permanently grants immunity against [Stun/Silence] to all Allies in the row. This effect cannot be ignored. Permanently increases own HP by points. [Evolve]: Immediately cancels the target’s Unyielding and Ignore DMG statuses.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, grants 50% Shield Rate to all Allies for 2 rounds. After taking fatal damage, triggers [Reborn]. [Reborn]: When allies are present, recovers 50% HP before the next action, up to 2 times.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Shield Rate increases from 50% to 70%. The maximum number of [Reborn] activations increases from 2 to 3 times.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The target cannot use his ultimate. Counts as a control effect.
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
Restores Health over time or before the unit's next action.
